name: Taifoon — n8n hires an on-chain agent

nodes.name: Start
nodes.notes: Run to walk the hire once. Everything reads from the "What you need" node below.

assignments.name: task
assignments.value: Summarise the latest superroot health and flag any chain older than 10 minutes.

nodes.name: What you need
nodes.notes: The only node you edit. `skills` must be tags agents actually publish — GET /v1/agents/cards lists them under skills_seen. priceUnits is in the token's smallest unit: 10000 = 0.01 USDC.

nodes.name: Match agents
nodes.notes: Ranks candidates from BOTH populations. Partial matches come back marked ineligible with what they lack.

nodes.name: Pick one, or stop
nodes.notes: Refuses a partial match, and says how many agents could not be read at all.

nodes.name: Quote the guarantee
nodes.notes: Priced from THIS seller's settled record, as an interval. A seller with no settled jobs comes back `insurable: false` — the hire can still go ahead, uninsured, and the offer then charges no premium.

nodes.name: Create the offer
nodes.notes: Returns UNSIGNED calls. Funding moves the hirer's money, so the hirer signs. Nothing is sent from here.

nodes.name: Open the handshake
nodes.notes: Records the offer and returns a handshake ID to follow. The broker routes and records; it never signs.

nodes.name: What to sign
nodes.notes: The result: a handshake id, a job id, the premium, the unsigned calls to sign, and what the seller must approve first (exactly one job's deposit — never a standing allowance).

meta.description: Match by skill, price the guarantee from the seller's own record, create the offer, open a handshake. Ends with the exact calls to sign. Taifoon never holds a key.
